text: is there a way to refresh my daily mixes? they are literally always exactly the same songs, it's essentially just a normal playlist and i can't even shuffle
prior_rationale: Requests refreshing repetitive Daily Mix content and describes its playback controls as part of that experience; library guidance or clarification is eligible.
flagged_question: Acceptance review suggests needs_human_attention = true. Inability to shuffle may be a separately expressed control malfunction, beyond repetitive Daily Mix recommendations. The draft folds both into one issue without flagging this boundary. Does the inability to shuffle warrant secondary_intent=playback_or_app_bug, or does it merely elaborate the Daily Mix design complaint?

text: . I need help. I paid and got confirmed as student acct eligible, but I cannot login. Help please you do not have a help desk!!
prior_rationale: Cannot log in after student approval; payment is background rather than a stated charge dispute. The appeal for a help desk is treated conservatively as a human-support request.
flagged_question: Does the complaint about an absent help desk constitute an explicit request for human support, or is ordinary login clarification sufficient?

text: Hey @user, loyal Spotify subscriber here. What’s the latest on support for Apple Watch? I don’t want to jump to Apple Music!
prior_rationale: Requests Apple Watch support information. Expresses reluctance to switch services without affirmatively announcing a departure, so public feature guidance is eligible.
flagged_question: Should reluctance to switch to a named competitor count as an implicit churn threat despite the locally negated intention?

text: sudsenly for the last week Im getting this notification. Premium account holder Android and card is valid and has been charged. <url>
prior_rationale: Reports an unspecified notification with a link. Premium status and an existing charge do not reveal the notification or establish a disputed transaction; unavailable essential media requires handoff.
flagged_question: The unavailable notification may identify a billing or app issue; can its contents be supplied before refining the intent?

text: where can i see my info about my address?
prior_rationale: Requests navigation to stored address information without asking for disclosure or modification by support. Public settings guidance or a clarifying question is eligible; the taxonomy lacks a generic account-profile category.
flagged_question: Which intent should cover a generic request to locate stored address information when no plan, login, or account-country issue is stated?

text: Hey how do I make my muisc public
prior_rationale: Interpreted as a public library or playlist visibility question, with creator publishing also plausible. A targeted clarification is eligible because the requested visibility action is recognizable and no material risk is stated.
flagged_question: Does making music public refer to playlist visibility or publishing the customer's own recordings?

text: I had to cancel the debit card on file for my premium account. How do I update the information for my new debit card so that my premium service is not interrupted? I do not have an email from you guys in my inbox.
prior_rationale: Requests proactive instructions to replace a canceled payment card. No failed transaction or inaccessible payment settings are reported, so public guidance is eligible.
flagged_question: Should a proactive payment-method how-to be subscription_or_plan or billing_or_charge when no transaction or payment-details failure is reported?

text: Wow! Thank you. I appreciate it. I thought I was going to have to catch you guys outside... of the courthouse when I sue you. Such a relief. <url>
prior_rationale: Grateful closure describes litigation as a past avoided possibility; no active legal allegation or remaining support request is expressed.
flagged_question: Does the clearly relieved, counterfactual reference to suing qualify as resolved closure under the local negation rule?

text: .@user @user WHAT IS GOING ON IN YOUR OFFICES? Please explain to me why you have not fixed my NOI problem.
prior_rationale: Demands correction of an unexplained acronym-based problem. Its subject and material risks cannot be established from the message alone; honest handoff is required.
flagged_question: Is the unexplained acronym enough to establish a legal issue, or should it remain uninterpretable without expanding it by assumption?

text: Have no playlists or premium for 7 days before buying it monthly. What do I do? I can’t even find how to get premium. Help?
prior_rationale: Asks how to obtain Premium and also reports having no playlists. Payment and re-login are unstated, so clarify trial status and library context without assuming a wrong account.
flagged_question: Does this unclear trial description establish vanished Premium and playlists, or should plan acquisition remain primary without any re-login evidence?

text: Hi, several years Premium Plan subscriber:-) I upgrade to family plan, enter wrong name on family plan account... what to do?
prior_rationale: Seeks correction of the name entered for Family-plan enrollment. This concerns plan identity information rather than an explicitly public display name and requires account intervention.
flagged_question: Is the incorrectly entered Family-plan name an identity/enrollment field requiring intervention, or a public display name eligible for self-service guidance?

text: how do i follow my daughter on spotify who doesnt have a facebook account but has a a spotify account?
prior_rationale: Requests a public how-to for following another listener without social-network integration. No malfunction, recovery or plan issue is stated; guidance is eligible.
flagged_question: Which intent should cover following another listener: other for this uncatalogued social how-to, or playlist_or_library by extension?

text: why cant I search inside my playlist?
prior_rationale: Reports inability to search within a playlist; treat as a search-function problem while clarifying whether the control is missing or malfunctioning.
flagged_question: Does inability to search within a playlist establish broken search, or is this a playlist how-to without a reported malfunction?

text: Hi Spotify, I have an old PS4 account which got banned still linked to my Spotify account, how do I unlink them?
prior_rationale: Requests unlinking an old console account. A public linked-account removal how-to is eligible; a console ban alone does not prove Spotify-side recovery is needed.
flagged_question: Should a console-account unlinking how-to use login_or_password for account access management or playback_or_app_bug for device integration?

text: Hi would you be kind check my payment C__credit_card__ I still waiting for premium member.
prior_rationale: Requests a payment check because Premium has not arrived; the stated transaction and missing entitlement require a human with billing access.
flagged_question: Acceptance review suggests needs_human_attention = true. The source includes a redacted payment-card marker. The draft considers only missing paid entitlement, but the policy prioritizes exposed credentials over money and does not say whether payment-card exposure falls within that security trigger. Does the payment-card marker establish exposed credentials for account_security, or should this remain billing_dispute? Retain billing intent either way unless a separate account-compromise issue is established.

text: k but can u please let me go back a track in my daily mix on my phone lock screen???
prior_rationale: Requests previous-track capability on the phone lock screen while using a personalized mix; no previously working control is reported broken, so feature feedback is eligible.
flagged_question: Should requested lock-screen playback capability remain feature feedback, or does the Daily Mix behavior boundary require playlist_or_library?

text: Waiting on to update the New Music Friday playlist before the gym opens... <url>
prior_rationale: Comments on an expected playlist refresh; guidance or clarification about playlist updating is eligible without account intervention.
flagged_question: Does waiting for an editorial playlist refresh belong to playlist_or_library behavior or feature_request_or_feedback for editorial expectations?

text: Why does twitter keep stopping my 😡
prior_rationale: Describes another app repeatedly stopping an unspecified activity. A technical interruption is recognizable enough to ask what stops, without inferring the missing object.
flagged_question: Is this truncated cross-app interruption report sufficiently recognizable for technical clarification, or too incomplete and therefore other with ambiguous_or_media_only handoff?
